snapshot.reason: The company reported a 118.8% increase in H1 FY27 PBT and a 38.8% growth in EBITDA, signaling strong operational leverage and effective capital deployment.
snapshot.why_now: The exchange filing confirming these results and a new ₹45 crore funding plan was released today, November 5, 2026.
source_headlines: Kalyani Forge Limited: Kalyani Forge Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 05, 2026, titled "Kalyani Forge Board Approves ₹45 Crore Funding Plan to Power Next Phase of Growth; H1 FY27 PBT More Than Doubles (+118.8%) and EBITDA Grows 38.8% YoY".
